summary: Booking site lists all three campgrounds: Firefly $40 full hookup, Flying Squirrel/Plains $30; high 30->40; count 139 hookup sites added; 14-night max and Fri+Sat rule added; season confirmed. Linn County's own site refuses plain HTTP.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (not waterfront -> riverfront looks earned for a few pads; I changed nothing): leaf-off imagery shows the river-flat loops' outer row with pads on the river side of the road and open mown grass to the Wapsipinicon bank. Scaled from a 440-m frame: about 17-30 m at the pads near 42.2191,-91.5441 and about 30-35 m at the pad near 42.2174,-91.5433, no road, driveway or day use between. Channel about 80-100 m wide (imagery; Overpass did not answer). Other pads sit inside the loops, behind a loop road, or behind a reed strip of about 60 m nearer the footbridge. Every Flying Squirrel page read (A-01, C-01) warns 'This is a flood prone site!', which fits river-flat sites. I can't give site numbers: the loop map is refused.

UNREAD: linncountyiowa.gov answers plain HTTP with a Cloudflare block, including the park map (DocumentCenter/View/14147) and the Firefly map (DocumentCenter/View/25866). Not retried another way. So I can't name which loop on the imagery is which campground.

BOOKING CONFLICT: park page says Flying Squirrel and Plains are first-come 'for 2025', yet the booking site lists all 83 + 24 with prices and a Fri+Sat rule. fcfs left at the stored some_sites. Whether those two take online bookings in 2027 needs the county: (319) 892-6450, the Conservation Office number on the facility contract. The entry stores no phone; apply.py doesn't write it.

PIN: stored 42.21792,-91.53876 is in unbroken trees about 230 m east of the nearest river-flat loop, though the note says it pins Flying Squirrel. Centre of the two river-flat loops is about 42.21895,-91.54272 (about 350 m off, read from imagery).

SPLIT: no. All three campgrounds share the north access (Valley Farm Road); Firefly is off Firefly Road by the same entrance. Firefly opened 2025 and I can't place it with certainty: imagery shows only a small loop with few pads at about 42.2160,-91.5373 east of the pin, about 500-600 m from the river-flat loops, and may predate it. The south access has lodges and group camp only.
